name: Continental Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Continental Chemicals Ltd offers IT and Software Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
CCL is engaged in providing Information Technology product-based services to its clients including computer programming, consultancy and related activities. It is in the business of sale, purchase and licensing of software within and outside India

cons: Stock is trading at 3.19 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.63% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.25% over last 3 years.
